name: smart-start-simple
description: IXT-SUITES: Smart Start (simple-tier one-click furnish). Present in Simple mode; the wizard modal opens with style cards, 'Furnish my flat' applies a layout (items populate) and closes the modal. Mobile leg.

steps.name: dismiss-overlays
steps.eval: try { localStorage.setItem('hdb_onboarded','1') } catch {}; const s = window.__store.getState(); s.endTour?.(); s.setOnboardingOpen?.(false); s.dismissLocationPrompt?.()

steps.name: assert-simple-present
steps.failMessage: Smart Start (simple-tier) should be present in Simple mode

steps.name: wizard-visible
steps.failMessage: Smart Start modal did not open

steps.name: assert-furnished
steps.failMessage: Smart Start did not furnish the flat / close
